fields: [0] = PositionHigh.xyz + Packed0W (resLevelBiasX, resLevelBiasY, AxisAlignedDirection, LightingChannelMask, bVisible, bHeightfield, bFarField)
layout.unused_bits: Packed0W bits 27..31 are unused/padding and are not decoded as flags
layout.axes: WorldOBB.AxisX/Y/Z unit axes stored as columns
layout.extent: ShuffleAxesNoFlip(MeshCardsExtent, PackedMeshCardsAxes), Z clamped to >= 1 cm

identity_evidence.imported_alias_reason: Lumen.Cards is a persistent pooled buffer imported into every graph; no per-pass producer version is exported, so the captured v0 payload is used only after the structural and temporal identity checks above

capacity.note: capacity is the GPU buffer allocation; the valid range is inferred as the contiguous nonzero uploaded card payload 0..NumCards-1 (the FLumenCardScene NumCards uniform is not exported). Tail slots are zero across origin/axes/mesh extent and flags.

representative_subset_rule: up to 24 included, centre-depth-visible, drawable cards whose projected hull area is closest to the candidate median, one per 8x6 screen cell, then filled in the same order; all numeric cards are retained regardless of this display subset
